about: An `audio` element with the browser's controls, as wide as its container. The controls are on unless `controls={false}`, because sound that plays for more than 3 seconds needs a way to stop it (WCAG 1.4.2), and speech needs a transcript in the page beside the player (WCAG 1.2.1).

controlled.about: A notification sound a reader previews from a button. The element's controls are off, so the browser renders nothing for it, and the button calls `play()` and `pause()` through a ref. Its words follow the element's `play`, `pause` and `ended` events.
controlled.title: Played from a button

memo.title: Voice memo from Ada, 13 seconds
memo.words: Hi, this is Ada from payments. The March payout to Northwind failed, because the bank rejected the account number. I have asked them to confirm it, and I will retry the payout on Monday.

title: Audio

transcribed.about: A voice memo on a support ticket, with the browser's controls and its transcript under a collapsible. The transcript states every word the memo says, so a reader who cannot hear it misses nothing. `preload="metadata"` loads the memo's length and nothing else until the reader presses play.
transcribed.title: With a transcript
